course_points.n: Continue straight onto b. d. St. Johanniskirche
Turn right onto Hinter der Sülzmauer
At roundabout, take exit 3 onto Bei Mönchsgarten
Turn slight right onto Lüneburger Straße
Turn left to stay on Bahnhofstraße
Hinterm Eichhof turns slightly left and becomes An der Ilmenau

points_of_interest.name: Dümpel an der Landwehr Forest Path
points_of_interest.description: Dümpel an der Landwehr Forest Path is a captivating circular trail nestled within the Palatinate Forest, a UNESCO biosphere reserve in the Pfalz region of southwestern Germany.
